svg.aria-label: Projects: Paper Analyzer — Scrapes TMV's DSpace repository and finds exam questions that repeat across years, then builds a PDF report.; AI Chat UI — Single-page chat interface with built-in diagram rendering and support for multiple AI providers.; Binance MCP — MCP server and trading-bot tooling for crypto futures on Binance.; Flashback Bridge — Mod patch that bridges CreamyKeys audio into Flashback replays and exports.
